title: My Turn to Ding
description: Nell wants to press the bus button all by herself! But waiting is hard when everyone else gets a turn. A sweet interactive story about patience and teamwork.
author: Early Roots

pages.text: Nell and Ari wait on the wet bench. Here comes the big red bus! Brrrm, swish. "Can I press the button today?" asks Nell.

2-4.en: Nell and Ari wait on the wet bench. Here comes the big red bus! Brrrm, swish. "Can I press the button today?" asks Nell.

pages.text: Ari smiles at her. "Yes. Watch for our stop." Nell jumps up. She wants to be the one to make the loud DING.

2-4.en: Ari smiles at her. "Yes. Watch for our stop." Nell jumps up. She wants to be the one to make the loud DING.

pages.text: Up the steps. Nell sits swinging her boots. She looks at the bright red button on the yellow pole. "My turn next?" she asks.

2-4.en: Up the steps. Nell sits swinging her boots. She looks at the bright red button on the yellow pole. "My turn next?" she asks.

pages.text: "Not yet," says Ari. A tall man stands up and pushes a button. DING! The bus stops. "My turn next?" asks Nell.

2-4.en: "Not yet," says Ari. A tall man stands up and pushes a button. DING! The bus stops. "My turn next?" asks Nell.

pages.text: The bus rolls on. Rumble, rumble. "Oh, the library!" says Ari. Without thinking, he taps a button. DING! "Hey!" says Nell. "That was my turn!"

2-4.en: The bus rolls on. Rumble, rumble. "Oh, the library!" says Ari. Without thinking, he taps a button. DING! "Hey!" says Nell. "That was my turn!"

pages.text: "Sorry, Nell," says Ari. Nell crosses her arms tight. "My turn next?" she asks softly. She wipes the foggy glass to see outside.

2-4.en: "Sorry, Nell," says Ari. Nell crosses her arms tight. "My turn next?" she asks softly. She wipes the foggy glass to see outside.

musicChallenge.promptText: Hum Nell's looking song while she clears the window.

pages.text: Look! There is the striped awning. The market! "Ari, look!" calls Nell. "Our stop!" Ari is reading his book. "Oh no, we are almost there!"

2-4.en: Look! There is the striped awning. The market! "Ari, look!" calls Nell. "Our stop!" Ari is reading his book. "Oh no, we are almost there!"

pages.text: Ari jumps up fast. They reach for the red button together. One, two, three... press! DING! The heavy bus slows down. Squeeeak.

2-4.en: Ari jumps up fast. They reach for the red button together. One, two, three... press! DING! The heavy bus slows down. Squeeeak.

pages.text: Out onto the dry pavement! Step, step, jump. Nell feels very proud. She remembered! She was the one who helped Ari find the stop.

2-4.en: Out onto the dry pavement! Step, step, jump. Nell feels very proud. She remembered! She was the one who helped Ari find the stop.

pages.text: They buy shiny apples under the big tent. "When we ride the bus home," says Nell, taking a bite, "it is my turn to ding all by myself!"
